stories.title: AMD shares rise 12 percent on Google Cloud partnership
stories.summary: Shares of AMD surged 12.5 percent to an intraday high of $504.80 on Monday. The company announced its fifth-generation EPYC server processors will power Google Cloud TPU 8tx systems. The collaboration aims to help enterprises deploy AI workloads, including inference, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, in the cloud.

stories.title: Wall Street recovers as AI sell-off cools
stories.summary: US markets rebounded Monday after the S&P 500 posted its largest weekly loss since April 2025. The Nasdaq rose 3.4% as dip-buyers entered the market, despite Nvidia shares falling 9%. Last Thursday, $2.3 trillion in value vanished from the Nasdaq 100 in a single session.

stories.title: HSBC shifts stance on Indian and Chinese equities
stories.summary: HSBC upgraded Indian equities to overweight, citing resilient earnings and reasonable valuations following a market correction. Simultaneously, the brokerage downgraded Chinese stocks to neutral. The firm noted a multi-year valuation reset for India, which it says has significantly underperformed emerging markets in recent years.

stories.title: Nifty holds steady after volatile session
stories.summary: The Nifty settled at 25,044 after a choppy day of trading. Foreign investors have injected over $4.1 billion into Indian equities this November, providing a floor for the market. Analysts suggest that after last week’s 8.5% rally, some consolidation is considered healthy for the index.

stories.title: Chemplast Sanmar shares surge on revenue growth
stories.summary: Chemplast Sanmar shares rose 11.4% on Monday, marking their largest single-day gain in 10 months. The company reported a 28% year-on-year increase in September quarter revenue to ₹1,323 crore. Investors appear to be responding to performance that exceeded market expectations.

stories.title: KPI Green Energy rallies on high volume
stories.summary: Shares of KPI Green Energy rose 9% on Monday, recovering part of the 23% decline recorded in October. Trading volumes were 64 times higher than the weekly average, despite no clear fundamental trigger for the movement. The stock remains volatile after struggling since April.

stories.title: KP Energy hits upper circuit ahead of earnings
stories.summary: KP Energy shares rose 20% to hit an upper circuit on Monday, ahead of its second-quarter results announcement. Trading volumes surged more than 10 times the usual level during the session. The company currently holds a market capitalisation of ₹1,389.52 crore.

stories.title: Piyush Goyal meets with Skoda Volkswagen
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met with Skoda Auto Volkswagen India representatives to discuss electric vehicle manufacturing and localisation. The talks focused on expanding automobile exports and enhancing India's position as a global automotive manufacturing hub. The government continues to push for domestic production targets.

stories.title: Boeing to reduce commercial workforce by 5%
stories.summary: Boeing will cut 5% of its commercial airplane staff to stabilize production rates. CEO Stephanie Pope stated that current output levels have left the company overstaffed. The layoffs suggest that the planemaker's efforts to repair its balance sheet and production schedule remain incomplete.

stories.title: Tata Motors subsidiary secures Iveco stake
stories.summary: Tata Motors, through its subsidiary TML CV Holdings, has reached a 96.25% shareholding in Iveco Group. The stake was attained following a voluntary tender offer that concluded with the acceptance of over 18 million common shares. The process was coordinated by BNP Paribas.

stories.title: BDR Pharma acquires Acme oral solids business
stories.summary: BDR Pharmaceuticals is acquiring a controlling stake in Acme Formulation’s oral solids business for approximately $250 million. The deal includes subsidiaries and is backed by private equity firm PAG. BDR says the acquisition supports its growth priorities in oncology and critical care.

stories.title: Godrej Properties plans massive launch pipeline
stories.summary: Godrej Properties intends to launch homes worth ₹32,000 crore in the second half of the fiscal year, doubling its output from the previous six months. Chairperson Pirojsha Godrej stated the company is on track to meet or exceed its annual guidance for sales and project completions.

stories.title: Prestige Estates buys Allure Developers
stories.summary: Prestige Estates has acquired a 100% stake in Noida-based Allure Developers for ₹523.76 crore. The deal grants the Bengaluru-based developer control over a residential project in Sector 150, Noida. The acquisition is part of a broader strategy to expand its presence in the National Capital Region.

stories.title: Meesho completes acquisition of Kirana Club
stories.summary: Meesho has acquired a 92.74% stake in Kirana Club for ₹186.71 crore. The deal provides the e-commerce firm with ownership of the technology platform and its Indian subsidiary, Retail Pulse Labs. The transaction was finalized through a series of share purchases earlier this month.

stories.title: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings files for IPO
stories.summary: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers for an IPO estimated at ₹9,500 crore. The parent of Coca-Cola's Indian bottling business expects to list on the BSE and NSE in 2027. Reports value the company at approximately $10 billion.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip India receives IPO approval
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has approved an IPO for MakeMyTrip India. The subsidiary of the Nasdaq-listed travel platform filed its papers confidentially in July. The parent company and ibibo Group Holdings are set to sell shares as part of the offering.

stories.title: Three firms bid for VOC Port project
stories.summary: Adani Ports, Megha Engineering, and Vishwa Samudra are competing for the ₹11,733-crore outer harbour project at VOC Port. The infrastructure development will be executed under a hybrid annuity model. The project aims to expand the port's capacity and strengthen its role in international trade.

stories.title: Jindal and Arvedi bid for Ilva steelworks
stories.summary: Jindal and Italian steelmaker Arvedi have submitted binding bids for the former Ilva steelworks. Special commissioners are now evaluating the offers to determine if they meet tender requirements. The Italian government is seeking a buyer for the industrial group, which is centered in Taranto.

stories.title: Payment apps reintroduce buy now, pay later for small purchases
stories.summary: Payment apps are reintroducing buy now, pay later services in India to capture young, first-time borrowers. Platforms like SuperMoney and POP are targeting small-ticket items such as sneakers and protein supplements. The industry hopes these small loans will initiate longer credit relationships with the next generation of shoppers.

stories.title: Crypto payments bypass traditional banking via QR loopholes
stories.summary: Web applications like goat.cash are allowing users to convert cryptocurrency into rupees for everyday purchases. By scanning a merchant QR code and loading USDC into a designated wallet, buyers can complete transactions in under two minutes. The process operates outside traditional banking channels using offshore digital assets.

stories.title: GST input tax credit changes boost manufacturing cash flow
stories.summary: Government changes to input tax credit mechanisms have increased cash flow by up to 2 percent for certain manufacturing sectors. While businesses have gained from refunds on rentals and tax rationalisation, these savings have not been passed on to consumers. The cost reduction remains within the corporate balance sheet.

stories.title: RBI extends board supersession at Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has extended the supersession of the Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank board for another year. Originally removed in 2023 due to poor governance, the bank remains under central oversight until at least November 2027. The regulator cited public interest for the continued management intervention.

stories.title: Sula Vineyards hit with tax demand over restaurant services
stories.summary: Sula Vineyards has received a tax demand for the 2022-23 fiscal year regarding its restaurant services. The order from the Nashik GST division disputes the 5 percent rate applied to the company’s RASA and Tasting Room operations. The firm now faces additional tax, interest, and penalties.

stories.title: FMCG brands ramp up advertising as macro pressures ease
stories.summary: Major FMCG brands increased advertising spending in the September quarter as macroeconomic conditions improved. Marico and Colgate-Palmolive reported annual spending hikes of 44 percent and 40 percent respectively. Companies claim they are using new tools to optimise these larger budgets as efficiently as possible.

stories.title: Jewellery retailers report growth through smaller festive purchases
stories.summary: Jewellery retailers saw healthy sales during the Dhanteras-Diwali period as customer footfalls increased. Buyers gravitated toward lightweight pieces and gold coins rather than high-value items. While the number of customers grew, the average bill value dipped, suggesting a shift toward more affordable festive spending habits.

stories.title: DPIIT plans budget push to localise 100 high-import items
stories.summary: The government is weighing targeted support in the upcoming budget to localise production for 100 critical import-heavy items. The DPIIT has identified gaps in sectors ranging from pharma to aerospace. The proposal aims to replace foreign components with domestic manufacturing to reduce dependency on international supply chains.

stories.title: Government expands mandatory gold hallmarking to six more districts
stories.summary: The government has extended mandatory gold hallmarking to six additional districts, bringing the national total to 398. The order requires jewellery sold in these areas to meet Bureau of Indian Standards certification. The move aims to strengthen quality checks for consumers in local markets across the country.

stories.title: TRAI sets new port charge ceilings for telecom interconnection
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has capped annual charges for IP-based interconnection ports, effective January 2027. Charges are set at 5.6 lakh rupees per 1 Gbps port and 42.3 lakh rupees per 10 Gbps port. The regulation now includes both legacy and IP-based port definitions.

stories.title: Proposed GST changes aim to lower dispute costs for MSMEs
stories.summary: Proposed changes to GST penalty provisions could reduce the compliance burden for micro, small and medium enterprises. The reforms, discussed at the 57th GST Council meeting, include raising the prosecution threshold and limiting proceedings for minor disputes. The goal is to ensure penalties remain proportionate to the errors.

stories.title: Private equity shifts toward asset-heavy strategies
stories.summary: Global private equity investors are moving toward asset-heavy businesses and lower leverage amid rising capital costs. According to S&P Global, the economy is transitioning from a focus on consumption-led growth to one driven by resilience and large-scale capital expenditure. Investors are now prioritising longer horizons over immediate efficiency.

research.title: Further Education During Unemployment
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Evidence on the effectiveness of retraining unemployed U.S. workers primarily comes from evaluations of training programs, a narrow avenue for skill acquisition. We use administrative records from Ohio to estimate the effects of retraining, broadly defined. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Sanctions, Evasion, and Deterrence: Evidence from Speeding Enforcement
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The design of sanctions plays a central role in shaping reoffending behavior. We study the effects of fixed monetary fines and accumulating penalty points on speeding recidivism and liability transfer. Exploiting a large increase in sanctions. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The Network Adaptive Market Hypothesis: Detection, Attribution, and Network-Mediated Efficiency
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose the Network Adaptive Market Hypothesis (NAMH), a novel extension of the adaptive markets framework that conceptualizes market efficiency as a network-dependent equilibrium emerging from long-memory predictability and cross-market information transmission. Using G20 equity indices. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
